# Custom Template live test brief

Create one Figma file named OpenClaw Custom Template — Live Test with three frames or components.

## Cover

- Frame: Cover
- Text layer: Cover title -> bind as Title
- Rectangle/image layer: Cover image -> bind as Image
- Text layer: Cover brand -> bind as Brand Name

## Content

- Frame: Content
- Text layer: Content title -> bind as Title
- Text layer: Content body -> bind as Body
- Text layer: Content page -> bind as Page Number

## CTA

- Frame: CTA
- Text layer: CTA title -> bind as Title
- Text layer: CTA action -> bind as CTA
- Text layer: CTA username -> bind as Username

Use any visual direction. The test must confirm that generated previews use duplicated layouts and leave the originals unchanged.
